items.title: Frank Naundorf Interview, 1965-02-25
items.q: The name 'Ich' is not mentioned in the transcript context. The interviewer mentions 'Ich will sort of... stay with it', which is a conversational filler/phrase, not a reference to a person named Ich.

ctx.x: Ich will sort of... stay with it at this point.

Do you want some more questions? Yes. Do you have some questions? Did you ask him about the parade there and the younger musicians you heard in them? Such as the trombonist with the Jefferson City Puzzards or the tuba player with the Lions?
